analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-10-21): SPY is in a mild uptrend (+0.2% vs SMA50, 20d slope +1.11%) — not a raging bull, but risk-on is the dominant regime. That said, the trading record demands humility: 0W/8L with avg loss -5.10% and a Sortino of -11.22 is a flashing yellow light. The stops are working mechanically (capital protected at -9.4% max drawdown), but we are not finding edge in stock selection. The honest response is to be highly selective and hold meaningful cash.

EXISTING POSITIONS: FOXA (+5.26%), IT (+19.02%), and ULTA (+8.14%) are performing well — thesis intact, hold. NVDA (+0.45%) is essentially flat and is showing MIXED/SIDEWAYS on the screened list (-2.8% vs SMA50); still within stop range, no thesis break yet, hold but watch closely. AMP (-10.87%) is the critical concern: it is NOT on the screened candidate list today, which likely indicates it has entered a confirmed downtrend and/or failed quality filters. At -10.87% from cost ($487.67 vs $547.12 avg), the position is approaching pain territory. The thesis should be reviewed immediately — if the downtrend is confirmed or the fundamental case has weakened, this is a manual exit candidate even though it cannot appear as a SELL in the JSON schema (not on candidate list). I flag this plainly: consider exiting AMP manually.

NEW BUY — ONE TRADE ONLY: ADBE is the standout quality-value setup from the screened list. Fwd P/E of 9.33 and PEG of 0.59 for a business with 61.9% ROE, 34.8% operating margins, and $9.3B FCF is strikingly cheap — the stock was at $360 twelve months ago and has been heavily punished. At 38% of its 52-week range, it is basing near the lower half, which satisfies the Weinstein Stage 1-to-2 criterion. The risk is the SMA50 slope is slightly negative (-0.3%), meaning trend confirmation is not yet clean. I accept this because the valuation margin of safety is very wide and the earnings date (Dec 9) is far enough out to let the position breathe. Headroom limits position size to ~$22,700. No other setups meet the asymmetry standard today — energy names (APA, EOG, MPC, CVX) are all at 97-100% of 52w range and extended far above SMA50; these are late-cycle entries forbidden by the rules. Staying disciplined and deploying only one measured position.

trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Adobe is a dominant design and document-cloud franchise with a 34.8% operating margin, 61.9% ROE, and $9.3B in annual FCF. At a fwd P/E of 9.33 and PEG of 0.59, the market is pricing in near-zero growth — a clear mismatch for a company still growing revenue 12.9% with AI-driven product expansion (Firefly, AI-native Creative Cloud). The stock was at $360 twelve months ago; the compression is sentiment-driven, not fundamental deterioration. TECHNICAL: At 38% of the 52-week range, ADBE is basing in the lower half exactly where the strategy seeks Stage 1-to-2 transitions. Price is +0.3% vs SMA50 and +1.3% vs SMA200 — trend is not confirmed up yet but it has stopped going down. SMA50 slope is -0.3% (barely negative) suggesting deceleration of selling. This is the asymmetric window: stop is tight (4.8%, 1.5x ATR), target is realistic (return toward $300, prior support zone), and the quality margin of safety is wide. Earnings not until Dec 9 — 49 days of runway before binary risk.
trades.exit_plan: Primary stop at $244.40 (1.5x ATR, 4.8% below entry — automated stop-loss order). Thesis break: exit immediately if ADBE reports accelerating revenue deceleration or margin compression at Dec 9 earnings. Time stop: if price has not made progress toward $275 by mid-December, reassess and potentially exit to free capital. Partial profit at $280 (raise stop to breakeven). Full target $300. Do not hold through earnings without >10% unrealized gain as cushion; if flat into Dec 9, reduce to half size before the event.
